qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the temperature time switch (1AZ)?
What torque value should be used for the coolant temperature sensor (2AZ) on M60/1/M60/2/M21/M51 engines?
How much torque is required for the coolant temperature sensor on all other engine types?
What is the torque specification for the temperature switch (3AZ)?
What torque should be applied to the temperature sensor - air (4AZ)?
What is the torque specification for the charge pressure sensor on holder (5AZ)?
Which sensor requires the lowest torque specification on this page?
qa_pairs.answer: The air-mass sensor on lower section of air filter housing (7AZ) requires 3.5 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What torque is specified for the twin temperature sensor with 4-pin plug-in connection (6AZ)?
Which sensor has the highest torque requirement according to this table?
qa_pairs.answer: The temperature switch (3AZ) has the highest torque requirement at 28 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What engine types use the twin temperature sensor (6AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: M41, M43, M44, S50, S52, M52, M62, and M73 engines.
